newsitem.title: GERMANY: Head of truck tyre business leaves Conti.
newsitem.headline: Head of truck tyre business leaves Conti.

text.p: German tyre maker Continental AG said on Monday management board member Klaus-Dieter Roeker would leave the company because of differences over business strategy.

Roeker, whose responsibilities would be taken over by Conti chief Hubertus von Gruenberg, was in charge of the company's truck and heavy equipment tyre business, and was reported to be under pressure to step down.
Continental sales in the first nine months of 1996 rose 2.6 percent to 7.63 billion marks, but truck tyre sales slumped 7.1 percent to 800 million marks under weak demand for heavy equipment.
Conti's supervisory board was expected to approve the move at an April 14 meeting, the company said.
